card.name: The start of web addresses (http)
card.fires_on: The word http at the start of a web address, mostly in citations and reference lists after 'Retrieved from' or 'See'. It also fires once on a stray character in a garbled symbol.

modes.label: http in citations
modes.description: The http that opens a URL in a reference, often after 'Retrieved ... from' or an angle bracket.

modes.label: http in links
modes.description: The http inside an href or a 'See' pointer to a site.

card.plain: It lights up on the 'http' that begins a web link, usually in a source citation.
